theory.scope: Finite deterministic checks, stochastic diagnostics and stated scalability budgets; no universal guarantee

config.calibration_protocol: Exact joint Haar prior, stationary state and Gaussian likelihood; predeclared first coverage_trials trajectories at terminal time; not robustness under drift
config.projection_protocol: Same passive observations; fresh independent unit queries supplied to every method at decision time
config.reconstruction_protocol: Same current observation; known noise; Prior mean uses isotropic LMMSE, other methods use conditional Wiener shrinkage
config.beamforming_protocol: Same passive snapshots; independent desired unit queries shared by all methods; average population interference-plus-noise output power, not a mean-SINR optimality claim
config.tuning: Matched nine-candidate families per task/horizon/noise on independent validation trajectories; grids broadened because validation selected previous grid boundaries, not because of test outcomes; constant GROUSE steps only; shrinkage includes both constrained endpoints and loading includes the isotropic limit; boundary selections retained
config.runtime_accounting: Per-task times include cumulative required updates, current requested mean and task action; other-horizon mean evaluations, quadrature audits, calibration integration and validation are excluded. Shrunk PCA uses the cheap EW-PCA implementation; Loaded covariance is beamforming-only; task times are not additive. Bingham/Mode timings include the general filter implementation overhead, not an asymptotic distinction from matching EW PCA.
config.state_process: Haar initial rank-one subspace, constant state, no forgetting
config.uncertainty: Paired 95% Student intervals over trajectories; eight within-trial queries averaged, not counted as independent replicates
config.scope: Controlled low-dimensional real Bayes decision study; not a claim of large-scale complex or drifting tracking superiority

spectral_series.scope: Rank-one real and complex; truncation bounds exclude floating-point rounding; no Hessian/Fisher certificate
